body_html:
@unibcarlson As a composition professor, Tumblr is a fascinating place. Some of the best fanfic and nanowrimo stuff out there.

If you want a turn key platform where everything works in push of a button try @microdotblog. $5 a month ($10 if you want podcasts). You can use a WordPress site on your own domain, Drupal, I am using Known right now.

Many options. Happy to help.
